title: Oman GKG share leads ZW=F returns 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT Oman GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads ZW=F log returns by 5 days (+) as Gulf shipping risk lifts grain and fertilizer freight; trade long ZW=F 5d [gdelt.gkg.oman_share -> finance.ZW=F.log_return]
message: Weak support: r=0.02 overall, 5d lag r=0.12; rule long ZW=F 5d gives 28 trades, hit 43%, excess +0.16%/trade, OOS 8 trades hit 50%, actionability 6/10 - worth a follow-up, not yet a repeatable rule

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.oman_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ZW=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 5 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: GDELT Oman GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads SPY log returns by 5 days (+); if SPY shows a similar edge the ZW=F result is a generic risk-on effect, not a grain-freight channel; trade long SPY 5d [gdelt.gkg.oman_share -> finance.SPY.log_return] (parent: R2-0042)
